every_claim_requires: human and AI-tool role separation where relevant
evidence_requirements.unsupported_claim_rule: Unsupported material claims must be withheld, not softened into implication.
evidence_requirements.verified_rule: VERIFIED requires exact committed or independently reproducible evidence.

permitted_content: approved RTS and Proof Engine identity
coarse current build scope and explicit non-goals
already-public repository evidence and approved P3 outputs
CASE-001 developer-transparency method without private or disputed personal context
inactive contact and opportunity placeholder that states no current offer or response guarantee
prohibited_content: private messages, screenshots, platform-private identifiers, recipient response status, or wait timing
credentials, secrets, private repository bodies, customer data, provider payloads, or confidential third-party material
health, family, employment-dispute, legal, financial, precise-location, or other sensitive personal details
raw prompts, long conversation exports, or typo-bearing private instructions
unsupported production, customer-value, revenue, outcome, or universal-generalization claims
human ranking, hiring decisions, support-recipient ranking, or global capability scores
active sales promises, pricing, contracts, delivery commitments, or support guarantees
automatic publication, automatic outreach, or cross-surface republication

review_attribution.human_scope: The project owner authorized the next bounded internal work item, not publication.
